DAY 15  : 2 TRADES 2 L's

Technical Analysis
My initial bias was to go short, because of the NWOG, but NQ did not sweep the ATH and left REH's in place. I first entered short, off of a 15 min RB/1 min breaker entry, but my mistake was not letting price close below the breaker, which i thought it did. Also, there was no OTE level to play off of. Human error there. There was also a 15 min bullish FVG right under, so that logically lowers my probability. Shouldn't have gone for a trade like that. Price stopped me out quickly after that. 

From then, i had my eyes on longs because of the REH draw. Price reacted off of 15m Bullish FVG so i used a 1 min breaker to enter. 15m level was in discount. only mistake was that there was an SMT that made NQ heavier. Totally missed that. Human error. But other than that, the entry looked good here. Just PA not being the greatest. Perhaps i could've waited for a reaction from the breaker into a 15sec entry. I'll ask boy. price did stop me out, but fully delivered right after. 

Psychological Analysis
I felt slow today from lack of sleep. Wasn't fully awake and that costed me a trade. I did ask myself in the first trade, is this a trade worth taking? and react entered off of candle movement. Bad. I need to watch myself for impulsive thoughts and actions like that. After getting stopped out, i wasn't so upset or anything. I was confirmed that the bias was shifted to longs. Second trade felt a lot more secure, though i also did hesitate on it as well. There was something fishy about the entry that i'm not sure what it was, but it did make me hesitate. oh it was because that price went below the breaker for a second. the risk management was fine, I couldn't get the BE sadly. From both losses, i didn't really feel any tilt anymore. Just noticed the errors that I have made and will use that to improve in the next trade.
